name: novadesk_benchmark_v1
description: Benchmark dataset for NovaDesk SaaS knowledge base. Contains questions across multiple categories to test different RAG retrieval scenarios.

questions.question: What is the current refund period?
questions.expected_answer: 30 days from purchase date

questions.question: How do I request a refund?
questions.expected_answer: Submit a refund request through the customer portal or contact support

questions.question: What is the cancellation fee for the Pro plan?
questions.expected_answer: No cancellation fee, but prorated refunds are not available

questions.question: What error code indicates rate limit exceeded?
questions.expected_answer: ERR-429

questions.question: What does error code AUTH-101 mean?
questions.expected_answer: Invalid API key

questions.question: What is the maximum payload size for the API?
questions.expected_answer: 10MB

questions.question: What are the differences between the 2025 and 2026 refund policies?
questions.expected_answer: 2025 policy had 14 days refund period, 2026 policy extended to 30 days

questions.question: Which refund policy is currently in effect?
questions.expected_answer: The 2026 refund policy is currently in effect

questions.question: What is the process for escalating a support ticket?
questions.expected_answer: Wait 48 hours for initial response, then contact support manager via escalation portal

questions.question: What are the SLA commitments for Enterprise plan support?
questions.expected_answer: 1 hour response time, 4 hour resolution time for critical issues

questions.question: How does data retention relate to the privacy policy?
questions.expected_answer: Data retention policy specifies 7 years for financial records, privacy policy governs how that data is protected

questions.question: What is the CEO's favorite color?
questions.expected_answer: I couldn't find sufficient information in the provided documents to answer this question

questions.question: What is NovaDesk's stock price?
questions.expected_answer: I couldn't find sufficient information in the provided documents to answer this question

questions.question: What are the pricing tiers and their features?
questions.expected_answer: Basic ($29/mo): 5 users, 10GB storage. Pro ($99/mo): 25 users, 100GB storage. Enterprise (Custom): Unlimited users, 1TB storage

questions.question: What are the API rate limits for each plan?
questions.expected_answer: Basic: 100 requests/hour. Pro: 1000 requests/hour. Enterprise: 10000 requests/hour

questions.question: Is the refund policy the same as the cancellation policy?
questions.expected_answer: No, refund policy covers returning products for money back, cancellation policy covers stopping service subscriptions

questions.question: What is the difference between data retention and data backup?
questions.expected_answer: Data retention specifies how long data is kept, data backup specifies how data is protected and recoverable

questions.question: How do I set up SSO for my organization?
questions.expected_answer: Go to Admin > Security > SSO Settings, configure SAML 2.0 with your identity provider

questions.question: What should I do if I get error code SYNC-503?
questions.expected_answer: Service temporarily unavailable, retry after 5 minutes or check status page

questions.question: What is the backup schedule and retention period?
questions.expected_answer: Daily backups at 2 AM UTC, retained for 30 days. Weekly backups retained for 1 year
